hard_blockers.description: Any critical security finding or invalid security contract blocks regardless of weighted score.
Any required execution contract validation failure blocks release.
A critical requirement without linked test evidence blocks release.
A critical requirement without linked implementation evidence blocks release.
Loss of an approval, security finding, constraint, requirement, or artifact reference across a supported transition blocks release.
Website source commit, data hash, branch, or validation status is incompatible with source Dev.

verdict_rules.pass: weighted_score >= minimum_weighted_score and blockers is empty and every dimension status is not fail
verdict_rules.block: any hard blocker exists or weighted_score < minimum_weighted_score or any dimension status is fail
